name: Fluora
source:
Fluora is a maid born in a family of servants who have served the God-world's royal family for generations. She currently acts as Lithia's caretaker and bodyguard.

She is a hard-working maid capable of getting things done, yet she lacks initiative.
Since she takes care of everything around the household, Lithia is a little bad at housework and cooking. Fluora feels responsible for this but can do nothing about it.

Likes: cleaning, cooking
Dislikes: shopping, calculation, planning

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/subcharacter.html]official website[/url]]

Before becoming a royal guard, she used to belong to the Intelligence Bureau of the Divine Realm. Rumor has it that she and the deputy director of the Intelligence Bureau are on bad terms.
